definitions.explanation: Having or using many colors. Used as a modifier to describe printing, dyeing, art, and design that involves more than one or two colors.

examples.japanese: {多色|たしょく}{刷|ず}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ポスター→ポスター：09598_posutaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{花瓶|かびん}→花瓶：02867_kabin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多色|たしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{釉薬|ゆうやく}→釉薬：23335_yuuyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The multicolored glaze on this vase is beautiful.

examples.japanese: {多色|たしょく}⟦ボールペン→ボールペン：00691_boorupen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{何色|なんしょく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: A multicolor ballpoint pen is convenient because you can use several colors with one pen.

notes:
Composed of {多|た} (many) and {色|しょく} (color). Primarily used as a modifier before nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, or in compound words. Common in printing, art, and product descriptions. The {多|た}+noun pattern is productive in Japanese (⟦{多目的|たもくてき}→多目的：18132_tamokuteki⟧, ⟦{多方面|たほうめん}→多方面：19726_tahoumen⟧, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多色|たしょく}{刷|ず}り: multicolor printing
- {多色|たしょく}⟦ボールペン→ボールペン：00691_boorupen⟧: multicolor ballpoint pen
- {多色|たしょく}⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧: polychrome printing
- {多色|たしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧: multicolored design

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦カラフル→カラフル：10803_karafuru⟧: colorful — a loanword with a more casual, everyday feel
- {極彩色|ごくさいしき}: richly colored, vivid coloring — implies brilliant, splendid use of many colors
- ⟦{単色|たんしょく}→単色：22209_tanshoku⟧: monochrome, single color — the opposite of {多色|たしょく}
